headline: Council denied a public bathroom order 5-6 and advertised an ordinance creating a tow zone on Albany Street and Fantasia Drive.
summary: The council denied a King order on permanent public bathrooms and porta-potties by a 5-6 roll call vote. It adopted a related Bergman order that asks for a process to find bathroom locations, along with reports on Amazon drones, Medicare plans, and police academy classes. It also adopted a resolution encouraging residents to gather signatures to review or revise the City Charter.
